svg.title: 11-capability
svg.desc: Current practical capability scales, with maximum length updated from the qualified1.5micrometre result: original SCBA approximately20atoms; Reference-seeded SCBA approximately100atoms; spatial approximation combined with the Thermal closure method up to1.5micrometres interacting length. Atom counts are approximate system sizes rather than the earlier40-active-atom/56-total-atom distinction. Crystal motifs use verified diamond-Si input positions and periodic-cell boundaries:24atoms in the left motif,96in the middle illustrative periodic extension, and separated short crystal motifs at right with omitted periods indicated by dots. The drawings are structural illustrations, not new calculated benchmarks; no exact100-atom calculation is asserted. The length capability does not establish the bulk diffusive limit. These practical scales are not universal algorithmic hard limits.
